description: Four terminal coding agents through their npm names: Kimi Code, CodeBuddy Code, Qoder CLI and Letta Code.
why: Each npm row is its agent's only witness except Qoder's, whose postinstall also writes ~/.qoder, so must_contain names both. Kimi Code, CodeBuddy Code and Qoder CLI follow Claude Code's and Gemini CLI's shape, and Qoder's postinstall carries Google's licence header, so those agents and codex-cli are forbidden: a new terminal agent must not be read as one already catalogued.
known_gaps: No agent is run, so state that appears on first use is unexamined: Kimi Code's ~/.kimi-code is proved by its curl installer in 84-linux-installers instead, and CodeBuddy Code and Letta Code carry no state directory.
Editor surfaces are not installed: the CodeBuddy IDE and extensions, and the Qoder IDE.
